title: SOC2 vs. ISO for Startups: Key Differences Explained | Cybersecurity Essentials
description:
Choosing between SOC2 and ISO for your startup? Get a clear understanding of their differences in our quick guide. Learn about SOC2's focus on data security and ISO's international policy orientation. Discover which certification aligns with your customer needs and how they overlap. Ideal for startups looking at U.S. and international cybersecurity standards.
